changes: Added Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md, an executable capability plan for Lattice Parallel Development covering shared contract freeze, workstream ownership, merge queue, shadow mode, fail-closed rules, dogfooding, and its relationship to Loop Engineering and sequential capability proof.
usage: Open Lattice-Parallel-Development-Capability.md from the repository root before running parallel baseline development. Use it to freeze the minimal shared contract, assign workstream ownership, keep higher-layer work shadow-only, merge through the queue, and unlock claims only in baseline order.
expectedOutcome: User can read one detailed execution document and understand that Lattice Parallel Development accelerates implementation while preserving sequential proof, fail-closed claim gates, and human handoff for unresolved authority or ownership conflicts.
actualTranscript: lattice validate --story=B-7621 --json passed; npm test ran npm run test:e2e and node packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-e2e.js, ending with ALL PASS; verification intent coverage was 3/3 covered for happy, edge, and adversarial document requirements.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible gap: the expected document exists and all three verification intents were covered. Runtime scheduler implementation is intentionally out of scope for this story.
limitations: This story delivers the execution document only. It does not implement a runtime parallel scheduler, new Lattice command, or new authority gate.
pitfalls: The worktree initially lacked built dist files, so npm run build was required before validate could run cleanly. Use explicit CLI flags with forceTakeover-style commands because positional JSON plus extra flags can parse poorly.
